scripts.build: pnpm --filter bookracy-convertor run build && pnpm --filter bookracy run build && pnpm --filter bookracy-api run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter bookracy-convertor test && pnpm --filter bookracy-api test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter bookracy-convertor exec tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && pnpm --filter bookracy run typecheck && pnpm --filter bookracy-api run typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter bookracy-convertor lint && pnpm --filter bookracy lint
